extractions.value: Patient had GlyR-ab-mediated autoimmune encephalitis with prominent brainstem involvement but without muscular rigidity, stiffness, spasms, or startle. He suffered three episodes of respiratory failure, the last followed by cardiac arrest and death. Serum GlyR-ab was negative early in disease but CSF was positive, suggesting intrathecal synthesis.
extractions.quote: Our patient presented with brainstem encephalitis though without the typical CNS hyperexcitability. He did show signs and symptoms of marked brainstem involvement, initially including dysphagia and later myoclonus, oculomotor disturbance, and apneas. He suffered three episodes of respiratory failure, the last one followed by cardiac arrest.
